scope: Actual managed gateway, SDK, pinned PostgREST and PostgreSQL. One environment fills its configured admission budget with temporary two-second RPCs, next request refused; neighbor returns a correct distinct value and target recovers. Temporary RPCs removed and keys revoked. Not global socket or multi-process DDoS protection.
checks: published REST budget matches the three-connection lab pool
configured concurrent requests admitted to actual REST
neighbor succeeds while target requests remain active
open-loop generator kept schedule without missed arrivals
sustained responses all match expected data or retryable rejection
sustained target includes successful and rejected work
target recovers after sustained arrivals drain
